title: PublicHealth AirPollutionClinicPanel

stats.done_summary: Completed the analysis of the daily panel data. Conducted EDA, fitted a Poisson regression model to estimate the effect of PM2.5 on respiratory visits controlling for covariates, and generated visualizations. The final report is saved in report/report.md and copied to air_health_policy.md as requested.
